text: Surrogate-gradient learning confronts the fact that the spike function S = Theta(V - V_th) has a derivative that is zero almost everywhere; in the backward pass only, the derivative of this non-differentiable ___ step function is replaced by a smooth surrogate such as the fast-sigmoid derivative.
explanation: Theta denotes the Heaviside step function, whose derivative vanishes almost everywhere; surrogate-gradient methods (Neftci et al. 2019; Zenke and Ganguli 2018) substitute a smooth surrogate derivative in the backward pass so that backpropagation-through-time can train the SNN.
